APPROVE_CONTENT — FINAL-v5
Reviewer: 01a0ff52-e0cc-7e81-b3ed-36b1d84d7a9a, nominated nonauthor; acceptance precedes this vote at #5972146339.
committee_epoch: appserver-utf8-locale-v1-before-votes

review_base_sha / sole ordered parent: 4875c5d3fe2872af2d2daf1f4a3f30bb1d0ab258

I explicitly approve this proposal's content within its stated conditions. Independent local saved-data/Git review verified all three full postimages and exactly three changed paths, preserving 131983 other base entries; the 45 manifest leaves plus manifest itself were restored. Base client, both existing test modules and LICENSE are byte-exact Git sources. Removing only the two codec keywords restores the entire base client, and removing only the registry append restores the entire base registry. The append precedes main(), so normal CLI selection includes the new module. No request, notification, IDs, journal or close code is otherwise modified; process factories still receive ordinary Popen-compatible keyword arguments.

The six saved owned-peer receipts retain the initial harness errors and corrected baseline failures. Their full wire bytes/hash and literal peer-source hash match. Independent stdlib decoding establishes that the valid Japanese/accent/emoji result and 4097-byte padding survive UTF-8 and differ under cp932, while raw 0x80 is accepted under cp932 but rejected by strict UTF-8. The two post-fix receipts show exact valid result or AppServerError plus UnicodeDecodeError, actual child exits 0, retired readers and closed journals. The saved author command returncode is 0 and full stderr names 12 passing tests; this is verified saved evidence, not a root rerun or independent Windows execution.

The proposal binary-diff digest was reproduced exactly using --abbrev=8 (6243 LF bytes, SHA-256 691ee4550101ecd394d56cb56261ba386262b71fe730e2f6c6d1b40f2f0c29e3). Our default 10-character abbreviation first failed that digest check; the original failure is retained, and whole Git image binding did not depend on abbreviation. Incorrect local saved-file suffix reads are also retained as reviewer errors, not scientific failures.

Conditions remain binding: combinations with #7094 stderr drainage or later pending-request ownership must preserve both changes and selections and undergo genuine nonauthor review of the actual current complete tree, raw ordered parents, dependencies/settings and test environment. This content vote supplies no current integration tuple, apply_id, platform-check result, sender authority, main permission, GUI/model result or recovered inference completion/usage. No consumed allocation, peer helper, producer or model call was replayed. Broad task #57 remains active.
